name: Kick Strike Casino - Lucky Number Game.
author: NikGameDev
description:
The casino game of lucky number.
Choose your lucky number.
Strike any number from the casino table except your lucky number when your turn came.
If you strike the other player's lucky numbers, then other players will be kicked out of the game.
If anyone else strikes your lucky number, then you will be kicked out of the game.
Players who stood still at the last moment will be winners.
Play with friends and family.
Play online with random stranger and make new friends. 

Download for Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=casino.game.luckynumber&hl=en
Download for iOS - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1533525220
